title.en: Volume 82 Book of Later Jin 8: Emperor Shao 2
title.raw: 卷八十二 晉書8: 少帝本紀二 Volume 82 Book of Later Jin 8: Emperor Shao 2

sentences.zh: 天福八年秋七月丁丑朔，京師雨水深三尺。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn in the eighth year of Tianfu, on the first day of the month (dingchou), rainwater in the capital was three chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn in the eighth year of Tianfu, floodwaters in the capital stood three feet deep.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，許州節度使李從溫來朝，進封楚國公。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Li Congwen, Military Governor of Xuzhou, came to court and was advanced to Duke of the State of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Li Congwen, prefect of Xuzhou, arrived at court and was promoted to Duke of Chu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以前河陽節度使皇甫遇為右龍武統軍。

translations.literal: On renwu, the former Military Governor of Heyang, Huangfu Yu, was made Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Huangfu Yu, former prefect of Heyang, was appointed commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以宣徽南院使李承福為同州節度使。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Li Chenfu, Commissioner of the Southern Office of the Palace Secretariat, was made Military Governor of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Li Chenfu, commissioner of the Southern Office of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed prefect of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，改陜州甘棠驛為通津驛，避廟諱也。

translations.literal: On guisi, Gantang Post Station in Shanzhou was renamed Tongjin Post Station, to avoid the temple taboo.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Gantang Post Station in Shanzhou was renamed Tongjin Post Station to observe the imperial temple taboo.

sentences.zh: 甲午，正衙命冊皇太后，以宰臣李崧充使，右散騎常侍李慎儀為副。

translations.literal: On jiawu, at the main court the order was issued to invest the Empress Dowager; the chief minister Li Song served as envoy, with Right Regular Attendant of the Imperial Riding Steeds Li Shenyi as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the court ordered the formal investiture of the Empress Dowager, appointing Chief Minister Li Song as envoy and Right Regular Attendant Li Shenyi as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸南莊，召從駕臣僚習射，路左農人各賜布衫麻屨。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Emperor visited South Manor, summoned the officials accompanying him to practice archery, and to farmers along the road each bestowed a cloth shirt and hemp sandals.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the emperor visited South Manor and summoned his accompanying officials for archery practice; to farmers along the roadside he gave each a cloth shirt and hemp sandals.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，右衛上將軍楊思權卒，贈太傅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on wushen, Right Guard General Yang Siquan died and was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wushen, Right Guard General Yang Siquan died and was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，分命朝臣一十三人分檢諸州旱苗。

translations.literal: On xinhai, thirteen court officials were separately dispatched to inspect drought-stricken fields in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, thirteen court officials were dispatched separately to inspect drought damage in the various prefectures.

sentences.zh: 涇、青、磁、鄴都共奏逃戶凡五千八百九十。

translations.literal: Jing, Qing, Ci, and Yedu jointly reported a total of 5,890 absconded households.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou, Qingzhou, Cizhou, and Yedu jointly reported a total of 5,890 absconding households.

sentences.zh: 諸縣令佐以天災民餓，攜牌印納者五。

translations.literal: Of county magistrates and assistants, five submitted their seals and credentials, citing natural disaster and starving people.
translations.idiomatic: Five county magistrates and their assistants surrendered their seals and credentials, citing natural disaster and famine among the people.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以前昭義節度使李從敏為左龍武統軍。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the former Military Governor of Zhaoyi, Li Congmin, was made Commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Li Congmin, former prefect of Zhaoyi, was appointed commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，尊秦國夫人安氏為皇太妃，帝所生母也。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on wuyin, Lady An, Madame of the State of Qin, was honored as Imperial Grand Consort; she was the Emperor's biological mother.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuyin, Lady An, Madame of the State of Qin, was honored as Imperial Grand Consort—the emperor's own birth mother.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，追冊故魏國夫人張氏為皇后，帝之元妃也。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the late Lady Zhang, Madame of the State of Wei, was posthumously invested as Empress; she was the Emperor's original principal consort.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the late Lady Zhang, Madame of the State of Wei, was posthumously invested as empress—she had been the emperor's original principal consort.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以金部郎中、知制誥馮玉為檢校尚書右僕射，充潁州團練使。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Feng Yu, Director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts, was made Honorary Right Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, serving as Training Commissioner of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Feng Yu, director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts, was appointed honorary Right Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue and training commissioner of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，前潁州團練使田令方追奪在身官爵，勒歸私第，坐前任耀州日，額外配民曲錢納歸私室故也。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Tian Lingfang, former Training Commissioner of Yingzhou, was stripped of his active ranks and titles and ordered back to his private residence, having during his former tenure in Yaozhou improperly levied extra tax money from the people and diverted it to his personal use.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Tian Lingfang, former training commissioner of Yingzhou, was stripped of his ranks and titles and sent home, because during his earlier tenure in Yaozhou he had levied extra taxes from the people and kept the proceeds for himself.

sentences.zh: 延州奏，綏州刺史李彜敏拋棄城郡，與弟彜俊等五人將骨肉二百七十口來投，當州押送赴闕，稱與兄夏州節度使彜殷偶起猜嫌，互相攻伐故也。

translations.literal: Yanzhou reported that Sui Prefect Li Yimin had abandoned the city and prefecture; with his brothers Yijun and five others he brought two hundred seventy of his kinsfolk to surrender; the prefecture escorted them to court, stating that he and his elder brother, Cizhou Military Governor Yiyin, had nursed mutual suspicion and attacked one another.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou reported that Suizhou Prefect Li Yimin had abandoned his post and fled the city with his brothers Yijun and four others, bringing two hundred seventy dependents to defect; the prefecture escorted them to court, explaining that Yimin and his elder brother Yi Yin, Military Governor of Xiazhou, had grown mutually suspicious and gone to war.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，夏州奏，差宥州刺史李仁立權知綏州。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Xiazhou reported that You Prefect Governor Li Renli was appointed acting Sui Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Xiazhou reported that Li Renli, prefect of Youzhou, had been appointed acting prefect of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，故絳州刺史張從訓贈太尉，追冊皇后之父也。

translations.literal: On guisi, the late Jiang Prefect Governor Zhang Congxun was posthumously granted Grand Commandant; he was the father of the posthumously invested Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the late Jiang Prefect Zhang Congxun was posthumously honored as Grand Commandant—the father of the posthumously invested empress.

sentences.zh: 甲午，夏州李彜殷奏：「衙內都指揮使拓拔崇斌等五人作亂，當時收擒處斬訖。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Li Yiyin of Xiazhou memorialized: "The intramural commanders Tubo Chongbin and four others raised a revolt; at the time they were captured and executed."
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Li Yiyin of Xiazhou reported: "Five intramural commanders, including Tubo Chongbin, had risen in revolt; they were captured and executed at once.

sentences.zh: 相次綏州刺史李彜敏擅將兵士，直抵城門，尋差人掩殺，彜敏知事不濟，與弟五人將家南走。

translations.literal: Subsequently Sui Prefect Li Yimin wantonly led troops straight to the city gate; men were immediately dispatched to seize and kill them. Yimin saw the affair could not succeed and with five brothers fled south with their families.
translations.idiomatic: Later, Suizhou Prefect Li Yimin led troops without authorization straight to the city gate; troops were sent at once to capture and kill them. When Yimin saw the plot could not succeed, he fled south with five brothers and their households.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「李彜敏潛結兇黨，顯恣逆謀。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Li Yimin secretly joined with violent partisans and openly indulged rebellious designs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Li Yimin secretly enlisted violent accomplices and openly pursued treasonous designs.

sentences.zh: 骨肉之間，尚興屠害；

translations.literal: Among blood kin he still raised slaughter;
translations.idiomatic: Even among his own kin he brought violence;

sentences.zh: 照臨之內，難以含容。

translations.literal: Within the reach of imperial favor he could not be tolerated.
translations.idiomatic: under imperial protection he could no longer be indulged.

sentences.zh: 送夏州處斬。

translations.literal: Send him to Xiazhou for execution."
translations.idiomatic: He shall be sent to Xiazhou for execution."

sentences.zh: 」丙申，幸大年莊，遂幸侍衛使景延廣第。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the Emperor visited Danian Manor, then visited the residence of the Palace Guard Commissioner Jing Yanguang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the emperor visited Danian Manor, then called at the home of Jing Yanguang, commissioner of the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 延廣進金玉器玩，賜延廣玉帶名馬，母妻、賓佐、部曲、僮仆錫賫鹹及之。

translations.literal: Yanguang presented gold, jade, utensils, and curios; the Emperor bestowed on Yanguang a jade belt and a famous horse, and gifts were extended as well to his mother, wife, retainers, household troops, and servants.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang presented gifts of gold, jade, vessels, and curios; the emperor gave him a jade belt and a fine horse, and lavished rewards on his mother, wife, staff, household troops, and servants as well.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以右諫議大夫邊光範為給事中，以吏部郎中劉知新為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Right Remonstrance Grandee Bian Guangfan was made Attendant Gentleman; Liu Zhixin, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Remonstrance Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Right Remonstrance Grandee Bian Guangfan was appointed Attendant Gentleman, and Liu Zhixin, director in the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed Right Remonstrance Grandee.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸州郡括借到軍食，以籍來上，吏民有隱落者，並處極法。

translations.literal: That month, the various prefectures and commanderies requisitioned military provisions by compulsory loan, submitted registers to the throne, and any officials or commoners found concealing shortfalls were all punished by the extreme penalty.
translations.idiomatic: That month, prefectures and commanderies forcibly requisitioned military rations and submitted registers to the throne; any official or commoner who concealed shortfalls was punished by death.

sentences.zh: 州郡二十七蝗，餓死者數十萬。

translations.literal: Locusts struck twenty-seven prefectures and commanderies; hundreds of thousands starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts ravaged twenty-seven prefectures and commanderies, and hundreds of thousands died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，制以吳國夫人馮氏為皇后，仍令所司擇日備禮冊命。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on wushen, an edict made Lady Feng, Madame of the State of Wu, Empress, and ordered the relevant offices to choose a day and prepare the ceremonial investiture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen, an edict made Lady Feng, Madame of the State of Wu, empress and ordered the appropriate offices to choose a day and prepare the formal investiture ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，封皇第十一妹為嘉興長公主，第十二妹為永泰長公主。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Emperor's eleventh younger sister was enfeoffed as Princess Chang of Jiaxing, and the twelfth as Princess Chang of Yongtai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the emperor's eleventh younger sister was enfeoffed as Princess Chang of Jiaxing and his twelfth as Princess Chang of Yongtai.

sentences.zh: 是夕五更，有彗見於東方，在角，旬日而滅。

translations.literal: That night at the fifth watch a comet appeared in the east, in the Horn constellation, and vanished after ten days.
translations.idiomatic: That night, during the fifth watch, a comet appeared in the east in the Horn constellation and faded after ten days.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以權知延州軍州事、前鳳州防禦使杜威為延州留後。

translations.literal: On renzi, Du Wei, acting administrator of Yanzhou's military and civil affairs and former Military Commissioner of Fengzhou, was made Yanzhou Surveillance Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Du Wei, acting administrator of Yanzhou and former defender of Fengzhou, was appointed surveillance commissioner of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以國子祭酒兼戶部侍郎田敏充宏文館學士，判館事；

translations.literal: On jiayin, Tian Min, Chancellor of the Directorate of Education and concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Academician of the Hongwen Hall and given charge of its affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Tian Min, chancellor of the Directorate of Education and concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue, was appointed academician of the Hongwen Hall with charge of its affairs;

sentences.zh: 以吏部侍郎張昭遠充史館修撰，判館事；

translations.literal: Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Compiler of the Historiography Institute and given charge of its affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed compiler of the Historiography Institute with charge of its affairs;

sentences.zh: 以給事中司徒詡充集賢殿學士，判院事。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman Situ Xu was made Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and given charge of its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman Situ Xu was appointed academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies with charge of its affairs.

sentences.zh: 西京奏，百姓馬知饒殺男吳九不死，以其侵母食也。

translations.literal: The Western Capital reported that the commoner Ma Zhirao killed his son Wu Jiu but he did not die, because the boy had encroached on his mother's food.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital reported that a commoner named Ma Zhirao killed his son Wu Jiu, who survived because the boy had taken food meant for his mother.

sentences.zh: 詔赦之。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以前延州節度使何健為涇州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the former Military Governor of Yanzhou, He Jian, was made Military Governor of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, He Jian, former prefect of Yanzhou, was appointed prefect of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以涇州節度使王周為陜府節度使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Wang Zhou, Military Governor of Jingzhou, was made Military Governor of Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Wang Zhou, prefect of Jingzhou, was appointed prefect of Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以左散騎常侍、權知開封府事邊蔚為工部侍郎，依前知府事。

translations.literal: On jisi, Bian Wei, Left Regular Attendant of the Imperial Riding Steeds and acting administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture, was made Vice Minister of Works and continued to administer the prefecture as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Bian Wei, Left Regular Attendant and acting administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture, was appointed Vice Minister of Works while continuing to administer the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以前兵部侍郎李玘為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On renshen, the former Vice Minister of War, Li Qi, was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Li Qi, former Vice Minister of War, was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命使攝太尉、右僕射平章事和凝，使副攝司徒、給事中邊光範追冊故魏國夫人張氏為皇后，奉寶冊至西莊影殿行禮，鹵簿儀仗如式。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the envoy He Ning, acting as Grand Commandant and Right Vice Minister with the title of Grand Councilor, and the deputy envoy Bian Guangfan, acting as Minister of Education and Attendant Gentleman, were ordered to posthumously invest the late Lady Zhang, Madame of the State of Wei, as Empress; they were to carry the seal and investiture document to the Shadow Hall at West Manor to perform the rites, with the full guard of honor as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, He Ning, acting as Grand Commandant and Right Vice Minister with the title of Grand Councilor, and his deputy Bian Guangfan, acting as Minister of Education and Attendant Gentleman, were ordered to posthumously invest the late Lady Zhang, Madame of the State of Wei, as empress; they were to carry the seal and investiture document to the Shadow Hall at West Manor and perform the rites with the full guard of honor.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，以鄧州節度使宋彥筠為晉州節度使，以涇州節度使何建為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on dingchou, Song Yanyun, Military Governor of Dengzhou, was made Military Governor of Jinzhou, and He Jian, Military Governor of Jingzhou, was made Military Governor of Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, Song Yanyun, prefect of Dengzhou, was appointed prefect of Jinzhou, and He Jian, prefect of Jingzhou, was appointed prefect of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以前鄴都留守、廣晉尹李德充為涇州節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao, Li Dechong, former Surveillance Commissioner of Yedu and Prefect of Guangjin, was made Military Governor of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Li Dechong, former surveillance commissioner of Yedu and prefect of Guangjin, was appointed prefect of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，所司奏議，故天下兵馬都元帥、吳越國王錢元瓘謚曰莊穆，詔改為文穆。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the relevant offices submitted a proposal that the late Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and King of Wuyue, Qian Yuanguan, be given the posthumous title Zhuangmu; an edict changed it to Wenmu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the relevant offices proposed the posthumous title Zhuangmu for the late Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and King of Wuyue, Qian Yuanguan; an edict changed it to Wenmu.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，遣前復州防禦使吳巒權知貝州軍事，詔節度使王令溫赴闕。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the former Military Commissioner of Fuzhou, Wu Luan, was dispatched to act as administrator of Beizhou's military affairs, and Military Governor Wang Lingwen was ordered to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wu Luan, former defender of Fuzhou, was dispatched to act as administrator of Beizhou's military affairs, and Wang Lingwen, the prefect, was ordered to come to court.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，單州軍事判官趙嶽奏，刺史楊承祚初夜開門出城，稱為母病，往青州寧親，於孔目官齊琪處留下牌印，臣已行用權知州事。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Zhao Yue, military affairs judge of Danzhou, reported that Prefect Yang Chengzuo opened the gate and left the city at the start of the night, saying his mother was ill and that he was going to Qingzhou to visit his family; he left his seal and credentials with the clerk Qi Qi, and I have already assumed acting administration of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhao Yue, military affairs judge of Danzhou, reported that Prefect Yang Chengzuo had opened the city gate at nightfall and left, saying his mother was ill and that he was going to Qingzhou to visit his family; he left his seal and credentials with the clerk Qi Qi, and Zhao Yue had already assumed acting administration of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，高麗遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Goryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Goryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 昭化軍節度使、瑞慎等州觀察等使杜建徽進封鄖國公。

translations.literal: Du Jianhui, Military Governor of Zhaohua Army and Surveillance Commissioner of Ruizhou, Shenzhou, and other prefectures, was advanced to Duke of the State of Yun.
translations.idiomatic: Du Jianhui, prefect of Zhaohua Army and surveillance commissioner of Ruizhou, Shenzhou, and other prefectures, was promoted to Duke of Yun.

sentences.zh: 遣侍衛步軍都指揮使郭謹領兵赴鄆州。

translations.literal: The Palace Guard Infantry Commander Guo Jin was dispatched to lead troops to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Guard Infantry Commander Guo Jin was dispatched to lead troops to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，遣左領軍衛將軍蔡行遇押兵士屯於鄆州，仍遣供奉官殿直二十六人，自河陰至海口，分擘地分巡檢，以青州節度使楊光遠謀叛故也。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month (yisi), Left Army Guard General Cai Xingyu was dispatched to escort troops to garrison at Yanzhou; twenty-six palace attendants of the inner hall were also sent from Heyin to Haikou to divide the territory and conduct patrol inspections, because Qingzhou Military Governor Yang Guangyuan was plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, Left Army Guard General Cai Xingyu was dispatched to escort troops to garrison at Yanzhou; twenty-six palace attendants were also sent from Heyin to Haikou to divide the territory and conduct patrols, because Yang Guangyuan, prefect of Qingzhou, was plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，前左禦正齊國夫人吳氏巳降二十一人，並封郡國夫人，太后宮、皇后宮知客夫人等亦如之。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the former Left Imperial Rectifier Lady Wu and twenty-one others who had already submitted were all enfeoffed as Madame of a commandery or state; the guest-receiving ladies of the Empress Dowager's and Empress's palaces were treated likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the former Left Imperial Rectifier Lady Wu and twenty-one others who had already submitted were all enfeoffed as Madame of a commandery or state; the guest-receiving ladies of the Empress Dowager's and Empress's palaces received the same honors.

sentences.zh: 太子太保致仕梁文矩卒，贈太子太傅。

translations.literal: Liang Wenju, retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died and was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Wenju, retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died and was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔河陽節度使符彥卿、宋州節度使高行周、貝州節度使王令溫、同州節度使李承福、陳州梁漢璋、亳州李萼、懷州薛懷讓並赴闕，分命使臣諸州郡巡檢，以契丹入寇故也。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict ordered Military Governors Fu Yanqing of Heyang, Gao Xingzhou of Songzhou, Wang Lingwen of Beizhou, and Li Chenfu of Tongzhou, as well as Liang Hanzhang of Chenzhou, Li E of Bozhou, and Xue Huairang of Huaizhou, all to come to court; separate envoys were dispatched to inspect the various prefectures and commanderies, because the Khitan had invaded.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, an edict ordered Fu Yanqing of Heyang, Gao Xingzhou of Songzhou, Wang Lingwen of Beizhou, Li Chenfu of Tongzhou, Liang Hanzhang of Chenzhou, Li E of Bozhou, and Xue Huairang of Huaizhou all to come to court; separate envoys were dispatched to inspect the prefectures and commanderies because the Khitan had invaded.

sentences.zh: 遣給事中邊光範、前登州刺史郭彥威使於契丹，行至恒州，敵已犯境，不能進，留於公館數月，不達其命而回。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman Bian Guangfan and the former Deng Prefect Governor Guo Yanwei were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan; when they reached Hengzhou the enemy had already crossed the border and they could not advance; they remained at the guesthouse for several months and returned without delivering their mission.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman Bian Guangfan and the former Deng Prefect Guo Yanwei were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan; when they reached Hengzhou the enemy had already crossed the border and they could not proceed; they remained at the guesthouse for several months and returned without delivering their mission.

translations.literal: Left annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: （《遼史》：天福八年二月乙卯，晉遣使進先帝遺物。

translations.literal: (According to the 《History of Liao》: in the second month of the eighth year of Tianfu on yimao, Jin sent envoys presenting the late emperor's personal effects.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《History of Liao》 records that in the second month of the eighth year of Tianfu, on yimao, Jin sent envoys presenting the late emperor's personal effects.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，晉遣使請居汴，從之。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Jin sent envoys requesting to reside at Bian, and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Jin sent envoys requesting to reside at Bian, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，晉主至汴，遣使來謝。

translations.literal: In the third month on dingwei, the Jin ruler arrived at Bian and sent envoys to express thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei, the Jin ruler arrived at Bian and sent envoys to express thanks.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，遣使如晉，致生辰禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jihai, envoys were dispatched to Jin to present birthday gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai, envoys were dispatched to Jin to present birthday gifts.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，晉遣使貢金。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on xinyou, Jin sent envoys presenting tribute of gold.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinyou, Jin sent envoys presenting tribute of gold.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁未朔，晉復貢金。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn on the first day of the month (dingwei), Jin again presented tribute of gold.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month of autumn, Jin again presented tribute of gold.

sentences.zh: 己未，如奉聖州，晉遣其子延煦來朝。）〉

translations.literal: On jiwei, he went to Fengsheng Prefecture; Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.) Right annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, he went to Fengsheng Prefecture; Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.) Closing editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以單州刺史楊承祚為登州刺史，從其便也。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Yang Chengzuo, Prefect of Danzhou, was made Prefect of Dengzhou, following his own convenience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yang Chengzuo, prefect of Danzhou, was appointed prefect of Dengzhou, as he had requested.

sentences.zh: 華州陜府奏，逃戶凡一萬二千三百。

translations.literal: Hua Prefecture and Shan Prefecture jointly reported a total of 12,300 absconded households.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Prefecture and Shan Prefecture jointly reported a total of 12,300 absconding households.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，臘，車駕不出。

translations.literal: On yichou, during the La festival, the imperial carriage did not go out.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, during the La festival, the emperor did not leave the palace.

sentences.zh: 詔前陜州節度使石赟率諸節度使畋於郡郊。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the former Military Governor of Shanzhou, Shi Yun, to lead the various military governors in hunting in the outskirts of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Shi Yun, former prefect of Shan Prefecture, to lead the various military governors in hunting in the outskirts of the commandery.

sentences.zh: 太子賓客聶延祚卒。

translations.literal: Nie Yanzuo, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Yanzuo, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔宣徽使劉繼勛就杜威園亭會節度使統軍等習射。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict ordered Palace Commissioner Liu Jixun to hold a gathering at Du Wei's garden pavilion with military governors, army commanders, and others to practice archery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, an edict ordered Palace Commissioner Liu Jixun to gather military governors, army commanders, and others at Du Wei's garden pavilion for archery practice.

sentences.zh: 淄州奏，青州節度使楊光遠反，遣兵士取淄州，劫刺史翟進宗入青州。

translations.literal: Zizhou reported that Qingzhou Military Governor Yang Guangyuan had rebelled, sent troops to seize Zizhou, and abducted Prefect Zhai Jinzong into Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhou reported that Yang Guangyuan, prefect of Qingzhou, had rebelled, sent troops to seize Zizhou, and abducted Prefect Zhai Jinzong into Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 是冬大饑，河南諸州餓死者二萬六千餘口。

translations.literal: That winter there was severe famine; in the various prefectures south of the Yellow River more than 26,000 people starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought severe famine; in the prefectures south of the Yellow River more than 26,000 people died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 開運元年春正月甲戌朔，是夕陣雲掩北斗之魁星。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the first year of Kaiyun, on the first day of the month (jiaxu), that night battle-array clouds covered the leader star of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of spring in the first year of Kaiyun, battle-array clouds that night covered the leader star of the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，滄、恒、貝、鄴馳告，契丹前鋒趙延壽、趙延昭引五萬騎入寇，將及甘陵，青州楊光遠召之也。

translations.literal: On yihai, Cang, Heng, Bei, and Ye sent urgent reports that the Khitan vanguard Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao led fifty thousand cavalry in invasion, about to reach Ganling; Qingzhou's Yang Guangyuan had summoned them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Cangzhou, Hengzhou, Beizhou, and Ye sent urgent reports that the Khitan vanguard Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao were leading fifty thousand cavalry in invasion and were about to reach Ganling—Yang Guangyuan of Qingzhou had summoned them.

sentences.zh: 己卯，契丹陷貝州，知州吳巒死之。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Khitan captured Beizhou; Administrator Wu Luan died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Khitan captured Beizhou; Administrator Wu Luan died defending the city.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以宋州節度使高行周為北面行營都部署，以河陽節度使符彥卿為馬軍左廂排陣使，以右神武統軍皇甫遇為馬軍右廂排陣使，以陜州節度使王周為步軍左廂排陣使，以左羽林統軍潘環為步軍右廂排陣使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Gao Xingzhou, Military Governor of Songzhou, was made Overall Commander of the Northern Field Headquarters; Fu Yanqing, Military Governor of Heyang, was made Left Wing Cavalry Battle-Array Officer; Huangfu Yu, Commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, was made Right Wing Cavalry Battle-Array Officer; Wang Zhou, Military Governor of Shanzhou, was made Left Wing Infantry Battle-Array Officer; and Pan Huan, Commander of the Left Feathered Forest Army, was made Right Wing Infantry Battle-Array Officer.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Gao Xingzhou, prefect of Songzhou, was appointed overall commander of the Northern Field Headquarters; Fu Yanqing, prefect of Heyang, was made left-wing cavalry battle-array officer; Huangfu Yu, commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, was made right-wing cavalry battle-array officer; Wang Zhou, prefect of Shan Prefecture, was made left-wing infantry battle-array officer; and Pan Huan, commander of the Left Feathered Forest Army, was made right-wing infantry battle-array officer.

sentences.zh: 太原奏，契丹入雁門，圍忻、代二州。

translations.literal: Taiyuan reported that the Khitan entered Yanmen and besieged Xin and Dai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan reported that the Khitan had entered Yanmen Pass and were besieging Xinzhou and Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 恒、滄、邢三州上言，契丹大至。

translations.literal: Heng, Cang, and Xing prefectures reported that the Khitan had arrived in force.
translations.idiomatic: Hengzhou, Cangzhou, and Xingzhou reported that the Khitan had arrived in force.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下餓死者數十萬人，詔逐處長吏瘞之。

translations.literal: That year, hundreds of thousands of people throughout the realm starved to death; an edict ordered local chief officials everywhere to bury them.
translations.idiomatic: That year, hundreds of thousands of people throughout the realm died of starvation; an edict ordered local officials everywhere to bury the dead.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔取此月十三日車駕北征，以前邠州節度使李周為權東京留守。

translations.literal: On renwu, an edict set the thirteenth day of that month for the imperial carriage to campaign north; the former Military Governor of Binzhou, Li Zhou, was made acting Surveillance Commissioner of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, an edict set the thirteenth day of that month for the emperor's northern campaign; Li Zhou, former prefect of Binzhou, was appointed acting surveillance commissioner of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，車駕發東京。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the imperial carriage departed the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the emperor departed the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敵騎至黎陽。

translations.literal: On dinghai, enemy cavalry reached Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, enemy cavalry reached Liyang.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞為前軍都虞候。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen, Palace Guard Cavalry Commander, was made Chief Adjutant of the Vanguard Army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen, Palace Guard Cavalry Commander, was appointed chief adjutant of the vanguard army.

sentences.zh: 河北危蹙，諸州求救者人使相望。

translations.literal: Hebei was in peril; envoys seeking relief from the various prefectures were visible one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei was in dire peril, and envoys seeking relief from the various prefectures came one after another.

sentences.zh: 戊子，車駕至澶州。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the imperial carriage reached Chuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the emperor reached Chuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以貝州節度使王令溫為鄧州節度使，時令溫弟令崇自契丹至，訴以舉族陷於甘陵，故有是命。

translations.literal: Wang Lingwen, Military Governor of Beizhou, was made Military Governor of Dengzhou; at the time Lingwen's younger brother Lingchong had come from the Khitan and complained that the whole clan was trapped at Ganling, hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lingwen, prefect of Beizhou, was appointed prefect of Dengzhou; at the time his younger brother Lingchong had arrived from the Khitan and reported that their entire clan was trapped at Ganling, hence the appointment.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鄴都留守張從恩遣人夜縋城間行，奏契丹主以鐵騎三四萬建牙帳於元城，以趙延壽為魏博節度使，改封魏王，延壽日率騎軍摩壘而退。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Zhang Cong'en, Surveillance Commissioner of Yedu, sent men who at night lowered themselves from the wall and traveled by secret routes to report that the Khitan ruler had established his command tent at Yuancheng with thirty or forty thousand iron cavalry, made Zhao Yanshou Military Governor of Weibo, changed his enfeoffment to Prince of Wei, and Yanshou daily led cavalry to press the walls and then withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Zhang Cong'en, surveillance commissioner of Yedu, sent men who lowered themselves from the wall at night and traveled by secret routes to report that the Khitan ruler had established his command tent at Yuancheng with thirty or forty thousand iron cavalry, appointed Zhao Yanshou prefect of Weibo and enfeoffed him as Prince of Wei, and that Yanshou daily led cavalry to press the walls and then withdraw.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以北京留守劉知遠為幽州道行營招討使，以恒州節度使杜威副之，定州節度使馬全節為都虞候，其職員將校委招討使便宜署置。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Liu Zhiyuan, Surveillance Commissioner of the Northern Capital, was made Pacification Commissioner of the Youzhou Circuit Field Headquarters; Du Wei, Military Governor of Hengzhou, served as his deputy; Ma Quanjie, Military Governor of Dingzhou, was made Chief Adjutant; staff officers and commanders were entrusted to the Pacification Commissioner to appoint at his discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Liu Zhiyuan, surveillance commissioner of the Northern Capital, was appointed pacification commissioner of the Youzhou Circuit Field Headquarters; Du Wei, prefect of Hengzhou, served as his deputy; Ma Quanjie, prefect of Dingzhou, was made chief adjutant; staff officers and commanders were left to the pacification commissioner's discretion to appoint.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大霧中有白虹相偶，占者曰：「斯為海淫，其下必將有戰。

translations.literal: On yiwei, amid heavy fog a white rainbow appeared in pairs; diviners said: "This is a sea inundation omen; below there will surely be battle.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, amid heavy fog a paired white rainbow appeared; diviners said: "This is an omen of inundation from the sea; battle will surely follow below.

sentences.zh: 」詔率天下公私之馬以資騎軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the requisition of all public and private horses throughout the realm to supply the cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered all public and private horses throughout the realm requisitioned to supply the cavalry.

sentences.zh: 丙申，契丹攻黎陽。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the Khitan attacked Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the Khitan attacked Liyang.

sentences.zh: 遣右武衛上將軍張彥澤等率勁騎三千以禦之。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanze, General of the Right Martial Guard, and others were dispatched to lead three thousand crack cavalry to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanze, General of the Right Martial Guard, and others were dispatched to lead three thousand crack cavalry to resist them.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣譯詔官孟守忠致書於契丹主，求修舊好。

translations.literal: On jihai, the interpreter-official Meng Shouzhong was dispatched to send a letter to the Khitan ruler seeking to restore the former friendship.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the interpreter-official Meng Shouzhong was dispatched with a letter to the Khitan ruler seeking to restore the former friendship.

sentences.zh: 守忠自敵帳回，契丹主復書曰：「已成之勢，不可改也。

translations.literal: Shouzhong returned from the enemy camp; the Khitan ruler replied in a letter: "The situation already established cannot be changed.
translations.idiomatic: When Shouzhong returned from the enemy camp, the Khitan ruler replied: "The situation already established cannot be changed.

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，太原奏，與契丹戰於秀谷，斬首三千級，生擒五百人，獲敵將一十七人，賊軍散入鴉鳴谷，已進軍追襲。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Taiyuan reported that in battle with the Khitan at Xiugu, three thousand heads were cut off, five hundred were captured alive, seventeen enemy generals were taken, the rebel army scattered into Yamming Valley, and the army had already advanced in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Taiyuan reported that in battle with the Khitan at Xiugu, three thousand heads were taken, five hundred men captured alive, and seventeen enemy generals seized; the rebel army scattered into Yamming Valley, and troops had already advanced in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰朔，遣石赟守麻家口，何建守楊劉鎮，白再榮守馬家渡，安彥威守河陽。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month (jiachen), Shi Yun was dispatched to hold Majiakou, He Jian to hold Yangliu Fort, Bai Zairong to hold Majiadu, and An Yanwei to hold Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, Shi Yun was dispatched to hold Majiakou, He Jian to hold Yangliu Fort, Bai Zairong to hold Majiadu, and An Yanwei to hold Heyang.

sentences.zh: 鄆州奏，博州刺史周儒以城降契丹，又與楊光遠潛約，光遠引契丹於馬家渡濟河。

translations.literal: Yanzhou reported that Bo Prefect Zhou Ru surrendered the city to the Khitan, and had also secretly agreed with Yang Guangyuan; Guangyuan led the Khitan to cross the river at Majiadu.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou reported that Bo Prefect Zhou Ru had surrendered the city to the Khitan and had also secretly agreed with Yang Guangyuan, who led the Khitan across the river at Majiadu.

sentences.zh: 時郭謹在汶陽，遣左武衛將軍蔡行遇率數百騎赴之。

translations.literal: At the time Guo Jin was at Wenyang and dispatched Left Martial Guard General Cai Xingyu to lead several hundred cavalry to the scene.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Guo Jin was at Wenyang and dispatched Left Martial Guard General Cai Xingyu with several hundred cavalry to the scene.

sentences.zh: 遇伏兵於葭葦中，突然而出，轉鬥數合，部下皆遁，行遇為賊所執，鋒鏑重傷，不能乘馬，坐畚中舁至幕帳。

translations.literal: He ambushed troops in the reeds; they burst out suddenly, and after several rounds of fighting his subordinates all fled; Xingyu was seized by the bandits, gravely wounded by blades and arrows, unable to ride a horse, and was carried in a basket to the enemy tent.
translations.idiomatic: He set an ambush in the reeds; the enemy burst out suddenly, and after several rounds of fighting his subordinates all fled; Xingyu was captured, gravely wounded by blades and arrows, unable to ride, and was carried in a basket to the enemy tent.

sentences.zh: 遣李守貞等水陸進兵而下，以救汶陽。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen and others were dispatched to advance by land and water downstream to relieve Wenyang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen and others were dispatched to advance by land and water downstream to relieve Wenyang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，先鋒指揮使石公霸與契丹遇於戚城之北，為契丹所圍。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Vanguard Commander Shi Gongba encountered the Khitan north of Qicheng and was surrounded by them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Vanguard Commander Shi Gongba encountered the Khitan north of Qicheng and was surrounded by them.

sentences.zh: 高行周、符彥卿方息於林下，聞賊至駭愕，督軍而進。

translations.literal: Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing were just resting in the woods when they heard the bandits had arrived; startled, they urged their armies forward.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing were resting in the woods when they heard the enemy had arrived; startled, they rallied their troops and advanced.

sentences.zh: 契丹眾甚盛，被圍數重，遣人馳告景延廣，請益師。

translations.literal: The Khitan forces were very strong; they were surrounded in layer upon layer and sent men in haste to inform Jing Yanguang, requesting reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan forces were overwhelming; surrounded on every side, they sent messengers in haste to Jing Yanguang requesting reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 延廣遲留，候帝進止。

translations.literal: Yanguang delayed, awaiting the Emperor's decision to advance or halt.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang held back, awaiting the emperor's orders.

sentences.zh: 行周等大噪，瞋目奮擊賊眾，傷死者甚多，帝自禦親兵救之方解。

translations.literal: Xingzhou and the others raised a great clamor, glared and fought fiercely against the bandit host; many were wounded and killed; only when the Emperor personally led the guard army to rescue them was the siege broken.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhou and the others raised a great clamor and fought fiercely against the enemy; many were wounded and killed, and only when the emperor personally led the guard army to their rescue was the siege broken.

translations.literal: Left annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·符彥卿傳》：契丹騎兵數萬，圍高行周於鐵丘，諸將莫敢當其鋒，彥卿獨引數百騎擊之，遼人遁去，行周得免。

translations.literal: (According to the 《History of Song·Biography of Fu Yanqing》: tens of thousands of Khitan cavalry surrounded Gao Xingzhou at Tieqiu; none of the generals dared meet their charge, but Yanqing alone led several hundred cavalry to attack them; the Liao men fled, and Xingzhou escaped.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《History of Song》, Biography of Fu Yanqing, records that tens of thousands of Khitan cavalry surrounded Gao Xingzhou at Tieqiu; none of the generals dared meet their charge, but Yanqing alone led several hundred cavalry to attack them; the Liao forces fled, and Xingzhou escaped.

sentences.zh: 《高懷德傳》：至戚城，被圍數重，援兵不至，危甚，懷德左右射，縱橫馳突，眾皆披靡，挾父而出。）〉

translations.literal: The 《Biography of Gao Huai'ede》 says: When they reached Qicheng they were surrounded in layer upon layer; reinforcements did not arrive and the danger was extreme; Huai'ede shot left and right, charged back and forth, all the enemy scattered, and he brought his father out.) Right annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: The Biography of Gao Huai'ede states that when they reached Qicheng they were surrounded on every side; reinforcements failed to arrive and the danger was extreme; Huai'ede shot in every direction and charged back and forth until the enemy scattered, and he brought his father out.) Closing editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: 登戚城古臺，置酒以勞三將，鹹咎延廣不遣兵赴難，相對泣下。

translations.literal: The Emperor ascended the ancient terrace at Qicheng, set out wine to reward the three generals, and all blamed Yanguang for not sending troops to their aid; facing one another they wept.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended the ancient terrace at Qicheng and set out wine to reward the three generals; all blamed Yanguang for failing to send troops to their aid, and they wept together.

sentences.zh: 戊申，契丹築壘於馬家渡東岸，以騎軍列於外，以禦王師。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Khitan built fortifications on the east bank of Majiadu and deployed cavalry outside to resist the imperial army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the Khitan built fortifications on the east bank of Majiadu and deployed cavalry outside to resist the imperial army.

sentences.zh: 李守貞以師搏之，遂破其眾。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen attacked them with his army and broke their forces.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen attacked with his army and broke the enemy force.

sentences.zh: 敵騎散走，赴河溺死者數千，遂拔其壘。

translations.literal: Enemy cavalry scattered and fled; several thousand drowned rushing into the river, and their fortifications were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy cavalry scattered and fled; several thousand drowned rushing into the river, and their fortifications were captured.

sentences.zh: 初，西岸敵軍數萬，鼓噪揚旗以助其勢，及見東岸兵敗，號哭而去。

translations.literal: At first, tens of thousands of enemy troops on the west bank beat drums, shouted, and raised banners to bolster their momentum; when they saw the east-bank army defeated, they wailed and departed.
translations.idiomatic: At first, tens of thousands of enemy troops on the west bank beat drums, shouted, and raised banners to bolster their momentum; when they saw the east-bank army defeated, they wailed and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 獲馬八百匹，生擒賊將七十八人，部眾五百人，送行在，悉斬之。

translations.literal: Eight hundred horses were captured; seventy-eight bandit generals and five hundred troops were taken alive, sent to the imperial camp, and all beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Eight hundred horses were captured; seventy-eight enemy generals and five hundred troops were taken alive, sent to the imperial camp, and all beheaded.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，夏州節度使李彜殷合蕃漢之兵四萬抵麟州，濟河，侵契丹之境，以牽脅之。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Li Yiyin, Military Governor of Xiazhou, combined forty thousand Tangut and Han troops, reached Lin Prefecture, crossed the river, and invaded Khitan territory to draw off their forces.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Li Yiyin, prefect of Xiazhou, combined forty thousand Tangut and Han troops, reached Lin Prefecture, crossed the river, and invaded Khitan territory to draw off their forces.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以彜殷為契丹西南面招討使。

translations.literal: On renzi, Yiyin was made Pacification Commissioner of the Khitan Southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Yiyin was appointed pacification commissioner of the Khitan southwest.

sentences.zh: 易州刺史安審約奏，戰契丹於北平，賊退保祁溝關，斷其橋梁而還。

translations.literal: Yi Prefect Governor An Shenyue reported that he fought the Khitan at Beiping; the bandits retreated to hold Qigou Pass, and he cut their bridges and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Prefect An Shenyue reported that he fought the Khitan at Beiping; the enemy retreated to hold Qigou Pass, and he destroyed their bridges and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，博州殘兵至自敵中。

translations.literal: On guichou, remnant troops from Bozhou arrived from the enemy camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, remnant troops from Bozhou arrived from behind enemy lines.

sentences.zh: 周儒之降也，賊執其軍士，將獻於幕帳，行次中途，守者夜寢，其中軍士一人自解桎梏，為諸兵釋縛，取敵戈矛，盡殺援者二百餘人，南走而歸，至河無舟，浮水而過，溺死之餘，所存者六十七人。

translations.literal: When Zhou Ru surrendered, the bandits seized his soldiers to present them at the command tent; midway on the march the guards slept at night; one soldier among them freed himself from his fetters, released the bonds of the others, seized enemy spears and halberds, and killed more than two hundred escorts; they fled south to return; reaching the river with no boats, they swam across; of those who did not drown, sixty-seven survived.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou Ru surrendered, the enemy seized his soldiers to present them at the command tent; midway on the march the guards slept at night; one soldier freed himself from his fetters, released the others, seized enemy weapons, and killed more than two hundred escorts; they fled south; reaching the river with no boats, they swam across, and sixty-seven survived.

sentences.zh: 是日，日有黃白暈，二白虹夾日而行。

translations.literal: That day the sun had a yellow-white halo, and two white rainbows flanked the sun as they moved.
translations.idiomatic: That day the sun was ringed with a yellow-white halo, and two white rainbows flanked it as they moved.

sentences.zh: 己未，滄州奏，賊眾三千人援送所掠人口寶貨等，由長蘆入蕃，以輕騎邀之，斬獲千餘人，人口輜重悉委之而走。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Cangzhou reported that three thousand bandits were escorting plundered people and valuables into Khitan territory via Changlu; light cavalry intercepted them, killing and capturing more than a thousand; the people and baggage were all abandoned as they fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Cangzhou reported that three thousand enemy troops were escorting plundered people and valuables into Khitan territory via Changlu; light cavalry intercepted them, killing and capturing more than a thousand; the enemy abandoned all captives and baggage as they fled.

sentences.zh: 庚申，宰臣馮道等再上表請聽樂，皆不允。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Chief Ministers Feng Dao and others again submitted memorials requesting permission for music; all were denied.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Chief Ministers Feng Dao and others again submitted memorials requesting permission for music; all were denied.

sentences.zh: 時帝自期年之後，於宮中間舉細聲女樂，及親征以來，日於左右召淺蕃軍校，奏三弦胡琴，和以羌笛，擊節鳴鼓，更舞叠歌，以為娛樂。

translations.literal: At the time, since the end of the mourning period the Emperor had occasionally had soft female musicians in the palace; since the personal campaign he daily summoned shallow-rank frontier military officers at his side to play three-stringed huqin, accompanied by Qiang flutes, beat time on drums, and alternated dancing and layered song for entertainment.
translations.idiomatic: Since the end of the mourning period the emperor had occasionally had soft female musicians in the palace; since the personal campaign he daily summoned low-ranking frontier military officers to play three-stringed huqin, accompanied by Qiang flutes, beat time on drums, and alternate dancing and layered song for entertainment.

sentences.zh: 常謂侍臣曰：「此非音樂也。

translations.literal: He often told his attending officials: "This is not music.
translations.idiomatic: He often told his attending officials: "This is not music.

sentences.zh: 」故馮道等奏請舉樂，詔旨未允而止。

translations.literal: Therefore when Feng Dao and others memorialized requesting formal music, the edict did not grant it and the matter stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when Feng Dao and others memorialized requesting formal music, the edict did not grant it and the matter stopped.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，楊光遠率兵圍冀州，刺史李瓊以州兵擊之，棄營而遁。

translations.literal: On renxu, Yang Guangyuan led troops to besiege Jizhou; Prefect Li Qiong attacked with prefectural troops, and Guangyuan abandoned his camp and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yang Guangyuan led troops to besiege Jizhou; Prefect Li Qiong attacked with prefectural troops, and Guangyuan abandoned his camp and fled.

sentences.zh: 冀州奏，敗賊軍於城下，見舁棺者，訊其降者，曰「戚城之戰，上將金頭王中流矢而死，此其櫬也。

translations.literal: Jizhou reported that the bandit army was defeated below the city walls; bearers of a coffin were seen, and when surrendered men were questioned they said: "In the battle at Qicheng the chief general Golden-Head King was struck by a flying arrow and died; this is his coffin.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou reported that the enemy army was defeated below the city walls; bearers of a coffin were seen, and when surrendered men were questioned they said: "In the battle at Qicheng the chief general Golden-Head King was struck by a flying arrow and died; this is his coffin.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以前鄧州節度使何建為東南面馬步軍都部署，率師屯汶陽。

translations.literal: On guihai, the former Military Governor of Dengzhou, He Jian, was made Overall Commander of Southeastern Cavalry and Infantry and led troops to garrison at Wenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, He Jian, former prefect of Dengzhou, was appointed overall commander of southeastern cavalry and infantry and led troops to garrison at Wenyang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，蜀人寇我階州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Shu forces raided our Jie Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Shu forces raided Jie Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉朔，契丹主領兵十餘萬來戰。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month (guiyou), the Khitan ruler led more than one hundred thousand troops to battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, the Khitan ruler led more than one hundred thousand troops into battle.

sentences.zh: 時契丹偽棄元城寨已旬日矣，伏精騎於頓丘故城，以待王師。

translations.literal: At the time the Khitan had feigned abandonment of the Yuancheng stockade for ten days already, concealing elite cavalry in the old city of Dunqiu to await the imperial army.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan had already feigned abandonment of the Yuancheng stockade for ten days, concealing elite cavalry in the old city of Dunqiu to ambush the imperial army.

translations.literal: Left annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：鄴都留守張從恩屢奏敵已遁去，大軍欲進追之，會霖雨而止。）〉

translations.literal: (According to the 《Comprehensive Mirror》: Surveillance Commissioner of Yedu Zhang Cong'en repeatedly reported that the enemy had fled; the main army wished to advance in pursuit, but continuous rain halted them.) Right annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》 records that Zhang Cong'en, surveillance commissioner of Yedu, repeatedly reported that the enemy had fled; the main army wished to advance in pursuit, but continuous rain halted them.) Closing editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: 設伏累日，人馬饑頓，趙延壽謀曰：「晉軍悉在河上，畏我鋒銳，不敢前進，不如徑造城下，四面而進，攻奪其橋梁，天下定矣。

translations.literal: Having lain in ambush for days, men and horses were hungry and exhausted; Zhao Yanshou proposed: "The Jin armies are all on the river; they fear our sharp edge and dare not advance. It would be better to go straight to the city walls, advance from all four sides, seize their bridges, and the realm will be settled.
translations.idiomatic: Having lain in ambush for days, men and horses were hungry and exhausted; Zhao Yanshou proposed: "The Jin armies are all on the river; they fear our sharp edge and dare not advance. Better to go straight to the city walls, advance from all four sides, seize their bridges, and the realm will be settled.

sentences.zh: 」契丹主然之。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 是日，前軍高行周在戚城之南，賊將趙延壽、趙延昭以數萬騎出王師之西，契丹主自擁精騎出王師之東，兩軍接戰，交相勝負。

translations.literal: That day the vanguard Gao Xingzhou was south of Qicheng; bandit generals Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao led tens of thousands of cavalry out to the west of the imperial army, and the Khitan ruler personally led elite cavalry out to the east; the two armies joined battle with alternating victories and defeats.
translations.idiomatic: That day the vanguard Gao Xingzhou was south of Qicheng; enemy generals Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao led tens of thousands of cavalry to the west of the imperial army, while the Khitan ruler personally led elite cavalry to the east; the two armies joined battle with alternating gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 至晡時，契丹主以勁兵中央出而來，帝御親軍列為後陣，東西濟河，為偃月之勢，旗幟鮮盛，士馬嚴整。

translations.literal: By the hour of shen the Khitan ruler led crack troops out from the center; the Emperor personally led the guard army arrayed as the rear formation; east and west they crossed the river in a crescent formation; banners were bright and fresh, troops and horses were strict and orderly.
translations.idiomatic: By late afternoon the Khitan ruler led crack troops out from the center; the emperor personally led the guard army as the rear formation; east and west they crossed the river in a crescent formation, banners bright and troops and horses in strict order.

sentences.zh: 契丹主望之，謂左右曰：「楊光遠言晉朝兵馬半已餓死，今日觀之，何其壯耶！

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler looked upon them and said to those at his side: "Yang Guangyuan said half the Jin armies and horses had already starved to death; seeing them today, how strong they are!
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler looked upon them and said to those at his side: "Yang Guangyuan said half the Jin armies and horses had already starved to death; seeing them today, how strong they are!

sentences.zh: 」敵騎往來馳突，王師植立不動，萬弩齊彀，飛矢蔽空，賊軍稍卻。

translations.literal: Enemy cavalry charged back and forth; the imperial army stood planted without moving; ten thousand crossbows fired together; flying arrows covered the sky; the bandit army gradually retreated.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy cavalry charged back and forth; the imperial army stood firm without moving; ten thousand crossbows fired together until flying arrows covered the sky, and the enemy army gradually fell back.

sentences.zh: 會有亡者告契丹主曰：「南軍東面人少，沿河城柵不固，可以攻之。

translations.literal: Then a deserter told the Khitan ruler: "The southern army's eastern flank has few men; the riverside walls and palisades are not solid and can be attacked.
translations.idiomatic: Then a deserter told the Khitan ruler: "The southern army's eastern flank is thinly manned; the riverside walls and palisades are weak and can be attacked.

sentences.zh: 」契丹乃率精騎以攻東邊，王師敗走，敵騎追之。

translations.literal: The Khitan then led elite cavalry to attack the eastern flank; the imperial army was defeated and fled, and enemy cavalry pursued them.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan then led elite cavalry to attack the eastern flank; the imperial army was defeated and fled, and enemy cavalry pursued them.

sentences.zh: 時有夾馬軍士千餘人在堤間治水寨，旗幟之末出於堰埭，敵望見之，以為伏兵所起，追騎乃止。

translations.literal: At the time more than a thousand horse-grooming soldiers were building a water fort on the embankment; the tips of their banners showed above the dam; the enemy saw them and thought ambush troops were rising; the pursuing cavalry then halted.
translations.idiomatic: At the time more than a thousand horse-grooming soldiers were building a water fort on the embankment; the tips of their banners showed above the dam; the enemy saw them and thought ambush troops were rising, and the pursuing cavalry halted.

sentences.zh: 久之復戰，王師又退，李守超以數百騎短兵直起擊之，敵稍卻。

translations.literal: After a long while they fought again; the imperial army retreated once more; Li Shouchao with several hundred cavalry and short weapons charged straight at them, and the enemy gradually fell back.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while they fought again; the imperial army retreated once more; Li Shouchao with several hundred cavalry and short weapons charged straight at them, and the enemy gradually fell back.

sentences.zh: 戰場之地，人馬死者無算，斷箭殘鏃，橫厚數寸。

translations.literal: On the battlefield, men and horses died beyond counting; broken arrows and spent arrowheads lay several inches deep.
translations.idiomatic: On the battlefield, men and horses died beyond counting; broken arrows and spent arrowheads lay several inches deep.

sentences.zh: 遇夜，賊擊鉦抽軍而退，夜行三十里而舍焉。

translations.literal: When night came the bandits beat gongs and withdrew their army; they marched thirty li by night and encamped.
translations.idiomatic: When night came the enemy beat gongs and withdrew; they marched thirty li by night and encamped.

sentences.zh: 護聖指揮使協霸

translations.literal: Guardian Sage Commander Xieba
translations.idiomatic: Guardian Sage Commander Xieba

translations.literal: Left annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: （協霸」二字上疑有脫文。）〉

translations.literal: (Above the two characters "Xieba" there is suspected missing text.) Right annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (Text is suspected to be missing above the name "Xieba.") Closing editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: 亡入賊中，夷其族。

translations.literal: He fled into the bandit camp, and his clan was exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: He fled into the enemy camp, and his entire clan was exterminated.

sentences.zh: 護聖第二軍都指揮使安重懷、指揮使烏韓七、監軍何彥超等臨陣畏怯，手失兵仗，悉斬之。

translations.literal: An Chonghuai, Commander of the Second Army of the Guardian Sage; Commander Wu Hanqi; Military Supervisor He Yanchao; and others were cowardly before the battle line and dropped their weapons from their hands; all were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: An Chonghuai, commander of the Second Army of the Guardian Sage; Commander Wu Hanqi; Military Supervisor He Yanchao; and others showed cowardice on the battlefield and dropped their weapons; all were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，契丹主帳內小校竊其主所乘馬來奔，云：「契丹已傳木書，收軍北去。」

translations.literal: On yihai, a junior officer within the Khitan ruler's tent stole his master's mount and came over in surrender, saying: "The Khitan have already issued wooden orders to gather the army and withdraw north."
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, a junior officer within the Khitan ruler's tent stole his master's mount and defected, reporting: "The Khitan have already issued wooden orders to gather the army and withdraw north."

translations.literal: Left annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: （《契丹國志》云：景延廣疑有詐，閉壁不敢追。

translations.literal: (According to the 《Chronicle of the Khitan State》: Jing Yanguang suspected deception, closed the walls, and dared not pursue.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Chronicle of the Khitan State》 records that Jing Yanguang suspected deception, closed the walls, and dared not pursue.

sentences.zh: 遼帝北歸，所過焚掠民物殆盡。）〉

translations.literal: The Liao emperor returned north; wherever he passed he burned and plundered until the people's goods were nearly exhausted.) Right annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao emperor returned north, burning and plundering wherever he passed until the people's goods were nearly exhausted.) Closing editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: 齊州奏，青州賊軍寇明水鎮。

translations.literal: Qizhou reported that bandit troops from Qingzhou raided Mingshui Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Qizhou reported that rebel troops from Qingzhou raided Mingshui Fort.

sentences.zh: 壬午，禮部尚書盧詹卒，贈太子太保。

translations.literal: On renwu, Lu Zhan, Minister of Rites, died and was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Lu Zhan, Minister of Rites, died and was posthumously honored as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 甲申，契丹車帳已過貝州，以趙延昭守貝州。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Khitan wagon tents had already passed Beizhou; Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Khitan wagon tents had already passed Beizhou; Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Beizhou.

translations.literal: Left annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: （《遼史》：三月壬午，留趙延昭守貝州，徙所俘戶於內地。）〉

translations.literal: (According to the 《History of Liao》: in the third month on renwu, Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Beizhou, and captured households were moved to the interior.) Right annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《History of Liao》 records that in the third month, on renwu, Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Beizhou and captured households were moved to the interior.) Closing editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，定州馬全節攻泰州，拔之，俘其兵士二千人，雜畜戎仗稱是。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Ma Quanjie of Dingzhou attacked Taizhou, captured it, and took two thousand of its soldiers prisoner, along with a corresponding amount of livestock and military equipment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Ma Quanjie of Dingzhou attacked Taizhou, captured it, and took two thousand soldiers prisoner, along with a corresponding amount of livestock and military equipment.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，北京留守、兼中書令劉知遠封太原王，餘如故。

translations.literal: On guisi, Liu Zhiyuan, Surveillance Commissioner of the Northern Capital and concurrent Grand Secretary, was enfeoffed as Prince of Taiyuan; the rest of his titles remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Liu Zhiyuan, surveillance commissioner of the Northern Capital and concurrent Grand Secretary, was enfeoffed as Prince of Taiyuan; his other titles remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔天下抽點鄉兵，凡七戶出一士，六戶資之，仍自具兵仗，以「武定」為軍號。

translations.literal: That day an edict ordered the realm to levy local militia: for every seven households one soldier was to be provided, six households were to support him, and he was still to supply his own weapons; the army designation was "Wuding."
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict ordered the realm to levy local militia: for every seven households one soldier was to be provided, six households were to support him, and he was to supply his own weapons; the army was designated "Wuding."

sentences.zh: 太常丞王緒棄市。

translations.literal: Wang Xu, Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xu, Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 緒家於青州，常致書於楊光遠，緒有妾之兄慊緒不為赒給，遂告與光遠連謀，密書述朝廷機事，遂收捕斬之。

translations.literal: Xu's family was in Qingzhou; he often sent letters to Yang Guangyuan; Xu's concubine's elder brother resented that Xu did not give him relief and reported that he was in secret collusion with Guangyuan, sending confidential letters describing court secrets; he was seized and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Xu's family was in Qingzhou, and he often sent letters to Yang Guangyuan; his concubine's elder brother, resentful that Xu had not given him relief, reported that Xu was in secret collusion with Guangyuan and had sent confidential letters describing court secrets; Xu was seized and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，車駕在澶州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer the imperial carriage was at Chuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the emperor was at Chuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 滄州奏，契丹陷德州，刺史尹居璠為敵所執。

translations.literal: Cangzhou reported that the Khitan captured Dezhou; Prefect Yin Jufan was seized by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Cangzhou reported that the Khitan had captured Dezhou and that Prefect Yin Jufan had been seized by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鄴都留守張從恩來朝。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Zhang Cong'en, Surveillance Commissioner of Yedu, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Zhang Cong'en, surveillance commissioner of Yedu, came to court.

sentences.zh: 丁未，加從恩平章事，還鄴。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Cong'en was given the title of Grand Councilor and returned to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Cong'en was given the title of Grand Councilor and returned to Ye.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔取今月八日車駕還京，令高行周、王周留鎮澶淵，近地兵馬委便宜制置。

translations.literal: On jiyou, an edict set the eighth day of that month for the imperial carriage to return to the capital; Gao Xingzhou and Wang Zhou were ordered to remain and garrison Chanyuan; nearby military forces were entrusted to their discretionary disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, an edict set the eighth day of that month for the emperor's return to the capital; Gao Xingzhou and Wang Zhou were ordered to remain and garrison Chanyuan, with nearby military forces left to their discretion.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，至自澶州，曲赦京城大辟以下罪人。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the Emperor returned from Chuan Prefecture and issued a partial amnesty for capital offenders and below in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the emperor returned from Chuan Prefecture and issued a partial amnesty for all but capital offenders in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，升冀州為防禦使額。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Jizhou was elevated to the quota of a military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Jizhou was elevated to military commissioner status.

sentences.zh: 同、華奏，人民相食。

translations.literal: Tong and Hua reported that the people were eating one another.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhou and Huazhou reported that the people were eating one another.

sentences.zh: 己未，以右武衛上將軍張彥澤為右神武統軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Zhang Yanze, General of the Right Martial Guard, was made Commander of the Right Divine Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhang Yanze, General of the Right Martial Guard, was appointed commander of the Right Divine Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以鄆州節度使、侍衛親軍都指揮使景延廣為西京留守；

translations.literal: On xinyou, Jing Yanguang, Military Governor of Yanzhou and Commander of the Palace Guard, was made Surveillance Commissioner of the Western Capital;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Jing Yanguang, prefect of Yanzhou and commander of the Palace Guard, was appointed surveillance commissioner of the Western Capital;

sentences.zh: 以宋州節度使高行周為侍衛親軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Gao Xingzhou, Military Governor of Songzhou, was made Commander of the Palace Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou, prefect of Songzhou, was appointed commander of the Palace Guard;

sentences.zh: 以侍衛親軍都虞候、義成軍節度使李守貞為兗州節度使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen, Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard and Military Governor of Yicheng Army, was made Military Governor of Yanzhou, continuing to command the army as before.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen, chief adjutant of the Palace Guard and prefect of Yicheng Army, was appointed prefect of Yanzhou while continuing to command the army as before.

sentences.zh: 是日，分命文武臣僚三十六人往諸道州府括率錢帛，以次軍用。

translations.literal: That day, thirty-six civil and military officials were separately dispatched to the various circuits, prefectures, and districts to levy money and silk in support of military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: That day, thirty-six civil and military officials were dispatched separately to the various circuits, prefectures, and districts to levy money and silk for military expenses.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以西京留守安彥威為晉昌軍節度使，以晉昌軍節度使趙瑩為華州節度使，以左龍武統軍皇甫遇為滑州節度使。

translations.literal: On guihai, An Yanwei, Surveillance Commissioner of the Western Capital, was made Military Governor of Jinchang Army; Zhao Ying, Military Governor of Jinchang Army, was made Military Governor of Hua Prefecture; Huangfu Yu, Commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was made Military Governor of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, An Yanwei, surveillance commissioner of the Western Capital, was appointed prefect of Jinchang Army; Zhao Ying, prefect of Jinchang Army, was appointed prefect of Hua Prefecture; and Huangfu Yu, commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was appointed prefect of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 是日，置酒宮中，召景延廣謂之曰：「卿有佐命之功，命保釐伊、洛，非酬勛之地也。

translations.literal: That day wine was set out in the palace; Jing Yanguang was summoned and told: "You have merit in aiding my accession; I appoint you to guard and govern the Yi and Luo region—this is not a place for rewarding merit.
translations.idiomatic: That day wine was set out in the palace; Jing Yanguang was summoned and told: "You have merit in aiding my accession; I appoint you to guard and govern the Yi and Luo region—this is not merely a reward for merit.

sentences.zh: 」因解禦衣、寶帶以賜之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Emperor removed his imperial robe and precious belt and bestowed them on him.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the emperor removed his imperial robe and precious belt and bestowed them on him.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，隴州奏，餓死者五萬六千口。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Long Prefecture reported that 56,000 people had starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Long Prefecture reported that 56,000 people had died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申朔，太原劉知遠奏，邊境未寧，軍用甚廣，所封王爵，乞未行冊命。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month (renshen), Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan memorialized that the border was not yet settled and military expenses were very great; regarding the enfeoffment as prince, he requested that the investiture ceremony not yet be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan memorialized that the border was not yet settled and military expenses were very great; he requested that the investiture ceremony for his princely enfeoffment be deferred.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣侍衛親軍都虞候李守貞率步騎二萬，討楊光遠於青州。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard Li Shouzhen was dispatched to lead twenty thousand infantry and cavalry to suppress Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard Li Shouzhen was dispatched with twenty thousand infantry and cavalry to suppress Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以鄴都留守張從恩為貝州行營都部署，

translations.literal: On dinghai, Zhang Cong'en, Surveillance Commissioner of Yedu, was made Overall Commander of the Beizhou Field Headquarters,
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Zhang Cong'en, surveillance commissioner of Yedu, was appointed overall commander of the Beizhou Field Headquarters,

translations.literal: Left annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：張從恩上言：「趙延昭雖據貝州，麾下將士久客思歸，宜速進軍攻擊。

translations.literal: (According to the 《Comprehensive Mirror》: Zhang Cong'en submitted: "Although Zhao Yanzhao holds Beizhou, the officers and soldiers under his command have long been away and yearn to return; we should quickly advance and attack.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》 records that Zhang Cong'en submitted: "Although Zhao Yanzhao holds Beizhou, his officers and soldiers have long been away and yearn to return; we should quickly advance and attack.

sentences.zh: 」詔以從恩為貝州行營都部署。）〉

translations.literal: An edict made Cong'en Overall Commander of the Beizhou Field Headquarters.) Right annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Cong'en overall commander of the Beizhou Field Headquarters.) Closing editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: 以滑州節度使皇甫遇為行營都虞候，以左神武統軍潘環掌騎兵，右神武統軍張彥澤掌步兵。

translations.literal: Huangfu Yu, Military Governor of Huazhou, was made Chief Adjutant of the Field Headquarters; Pan Huan, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was put in charge of cavalry; Zhang Yanze, Commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, was put in charge of infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Yu, prefect of Huazhou, was appointed chief adjutant of the field headquarters; Pan Huan, commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was put in charge of cavalry; and Zhang Yanze, commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, was put in charge of infantry.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，張從恩奏，貝州賊將趙延昭縱火大掠，棄城而遁。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Zhang Cong'en reported that the Beizhou bandit general Zhao Yanzhao set fires and plundered extensively, then abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Zhang Cong'en reported that the Beizhou rebel general Zhao Yanzhao set fires and plundered extensively, then abandoned the city and fled.

translations.literal: Left annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：延昭屯於瀛、莫，阻水自固。）〉

translations.literal: (According to the 《Comprehensive Mirror》: Yanzhao encamped at Ying and Mo, using water as a barrier to secure himself.) Right annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》 records that Yanzhao encamped at Ying and Mo, using water as a barrier to secure himself.) Closing editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: 以李守貞為青州行營都部署，以河陽節度使符彥卿副之。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen was made Overall Commander of the Qingzhou Field Headquarters, with Fu Yanqing, Military Governor of Heyang, as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was appointed overall commander of the Qingzhou Field Headquarters, with Fu Yanqing, prefect of Heyang, as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以鄧州節度使何建為貝州永清軍節度使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, He Jian, Military Governor of Dengzhou, was made Military Governor of the Yongqing Army of Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, He Jian, prefect of Dengzhou, was appointed prefect of the Yongqing Army of Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，澤潞上言，餓死者凡五千餘人。

translations.literal: That month Ze and Lu reported that more than five thousand people had starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ze and Lu reported that more than five thousand people had died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑朔，王師拔淄州，斬楊光遠偽署刺史劉翰。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month (xinchou), the imperial army captured Zizhou and beheaded Liu Han, whom Yang Guangyuan had falsely appointed prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, the imperial army captured Zizhou and beheaded Liu Han, whom Yang Guangyuan had falsely appointed prefect.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以太尉、兼侍中馮道為檢校太師、兼侍中，充同州節度使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Feng Dao, Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant, was made Honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant, serving as Military Governor of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Feng Dao, Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant, was appointed honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant, serving as prefect of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔復置樞密院。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict restored the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, an edict restored the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以侍中桑維翰為中書令，充樞密使。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Palace Attendant Sang Weihan was made Grand Secretary and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Palace Attendant Sang Weihan was appointed Grand Secretary and commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 權開封府尹李周卒，輟朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: Li Zhou, acting Prefect of Kaifeng, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhou, acting Prefect of Kaifeng, died; court was suspended, and he was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以邢州節度使安叔千為晉州節度使，加同平章事；

translations.literal: On xinhai, An Shuqian, Military Governor of Xingzhou, was made Military Governor of Jinzhou and given the title of Associate Grand Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, An Shuqian, prefect of Xingzhou, was appointed prefect of Jinzhou and given the title of Associate Grand Councilor;

sentences.zh: 以晉州節度使宋彥筠為陜州節度使；

translations.literal: Song Yanyun, Military Governor of Jinzhou, was made Military Governor of Shan Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Song Yanyun, prefect of Jinzhou, was appointed prefect of Shan Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 以吏部郎中李穀充樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Li Gu, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu, director in the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，滑州河決，漂註曹、單、濮、鄆等州之境，環梁山合於汶、濟。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Yellow River breached its banks at Huazhou, flooding the territories of Cao, Dan, Pu, Yan, and other prefectures; it encircled Liangshan and joined the Wen and Ji rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Yellow River breached its banks at Huazhou, flooding Cao, Dan, Pu, Yan, and other prefectures; it encircled Liangshan and joined the Wen and Ji rivers.

translations.literal: Left annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·楊昭儉傳》：河決數郡，大發丁夫，以本部帥董其役，既而塞之。

translations.literal: (According to the 《History of Song·Biography of Yang Zhaojian》: the river breached in several commanderies; corvée labor was massively mobilized; the commander of the local circuit supervised the work, and afterward the breach was sealed.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《History of Song》, Biography of Yang Zhaojian, records that the river breached in several commanderies; corvée labor was massively mobilized; the commander of the local circuit supervised the work, and afterward the breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 晉少主喜，詔立碑紀其事。

translations.literal: The Later Jin emperor was pleased and ordered a stele erected to record the affair.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Jin emperor was pleased and ordered a stele erected to commemorate the affair.

sentences.zh: 昭儉表諫曰：「陛下刻石紀功，不若降哀痛之詔；
