translations.literal: Zhaojian submitted a memorial remonstrating: "Your Majesty, carving stone to record merit is not as good as issuing an edict of grief and compassion;
translations.idiomatic: Zhaojian submitted a memorial remonstrating: "Your Majesty, carving stone to record merit is not as good as issuing an edict of grief and compassion;

sentences.zh: 摛翰頌美，不若頒罪己之文。

translations.literal: composing prose in praise is not as good as promulgating a text of self-reproach.
translations.idiomatic: composing prose in praise is not as good as promulgating a text of self-reproach.

sentences.zh: 」言甚切至，少主嗟賞之，卒罷其事。）〉

translations.literal: His words were very earnest; the emperor sighed in admiration and in the end abandoned the matter.) Right annotation bracket.
translations.idiomatic: His words were very earnest; the emperor sighed in admiration and in the end abandoned the matter.) Closing editorial annotation.

sentences.zh: 戊午，升府州為團練使額。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Fu Prefecture was elevated to the quota of a training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Fu Prefecture was elevated to training commissioner status.

sentences.zh: 庚申，襄州獻白鵲。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Xiang Prefecture presented a white magpie.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Xiang Prefecture presented a white magpie.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復置翰林學士。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Hanlin Academicians were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Hanlin Academicians were restored.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宰臣等三上表請聽樂，詔允之。

translations.literal: On yichou, the chief ministers and others submitted memorials three times requesting permission for music; an edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the chief ministers and others submitted memorials three times requesting permission for music; an edict granted their request.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以門下侍郎王松為左丞；

translations.literal: On wuchen, Wang Song, Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, was made Left Vice Director;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wang Song, Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Left Vice Director;

sentences.zh: 以右丞王易簡為吏部侍郎；

translations.literal: Wang Yijian, Right Vice Director, was made Vice Minister of Personnel;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yijian, Right Vice Director, was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel;

sentences.zh: 以右散騎常侍蕭願為秘書監；

translations.literal: Xiao Yuan, Right Regular Attendant of the Imperial Riding Steeds, was made Director of the Imperial Library;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yuan, Right Regular Attendant, was appointed Director of the Imperial Library;

sentences.zh: 以右諫議大夫王仁裕為給事中；

translations.literal: Wang Renyu, Right Remonstrance Grandee, was made Attendant Gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Renyu, Right Remonstrance Grandee, was appointed Attendant Gentleman;

sentences.zh: 以給事中李式為左散騎常侍；

translations.literal: Li Shi, Attendant Gentleman, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Imperial Riding Steeds;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi, Attendant Gentleman, was appointed Left Regular Attendant;

sentences.zh: 以金部郎中、知制誥徐臺符為翰林學士；

translations.literal: Xu Taifu, Director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts, was made Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Taifu, director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts, was appointed Hanlin Academician;

sentences.zh: 以禮部郎中李浣本官知制誥，充翰林學士；

translations.literal: Li Huan, Director in the Ministry of Rites, retained his original office and served as drafter of edicts, acting as Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan, director in the Ministry of Rites, retained his original office and served as drafter of edicts, acting as Hanlin Academician;

sentences.zh: 以刑部郎中劉溫叟改都官郎中，充翰林學士；

translations.literal: Liu Wensou, Director in the Ministry of Justice, was changed to Director in the Ministry of Justice's Bureau of Punishments and acted as Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wensou, director in the Ministry of Justice, was reassigned to Director in the Bureau of Punishments and appointed Hanlin Academician;

sentences.zh: 以主客員外郎範質充翰林學士；

translations.literal: Fan Zhi, Assistant Director in the Ministry of Rites' Bureau of Receptions, was made Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhi, assistant director in the Bureau of Receptions, was appointed Hanlin Academician;

sentences.zh: 御史張宜改倉部員外郎、知制誥。

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Yi was changed to Assistant Director in the Ministry of Revenue's Bureau of Granaries and drafter of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Yi was reassigned to Assistant Director in the Bureau of Granaries and appointed drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前晉州節度使周密為左龍武統軍，以同州節度使李懷忠為左羽林統軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Zhou Mi, former Military Governor of Jinzhou, was made Commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army; Li Huaizhong, Military Governor of Tongzhou, was made Commander of the Left Feathered Forest Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Zhou Mi, former prefect of Jinzhou, was appointed commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, and Li Huaizhong, prefect of Tongzhou, was appointed commander of the Left Feathered Forest Army.
